default.description: Local shell capabilities: the fallback page runs with no plugin permissions; the daemon UI is remote content granted nothing.

proxy.description: IPC for the bundled UI's connection picker (AC5) and the app-managed local daemon (ADR-0013 part D2): list/add/remove/select a daemon connection (by URL or, via connections_add_relay, a relay pairing URL), read the current one, open an http(s) link in the OS browser, install/update/restart/take-over the local daemon, reveal a local path in Finder/Explorer or open it in a detected editor (desktop-native-feel D4: the webview only ever names an allowlisted editor id, never an executable), and (desktop-native-feel D1) drive the main window: minimize/maximize/close/drag, read maximized/fullscreen state, report the UI's first paint, and mirror the theme. No command exposes relay key material. Scoped to the loopback proxy origin only -- the daemon/relay content served through it never gets these commands.
